  Scenario: AC9 An answer that needs the transfer reason list is not guessed when the list is not available (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given test user "U-7402" holds RW-TEAMMGR with default scope "TEAM" in team "TDR-BKK"
    Given the read of LOV-TRANSFER-REASON through DP-07 is not available
    When "U-7402" asks for case "RW-2026-000301", area "QUEUE_AND_ALLOCATION", right "U", action "transfer the case" and transfer reason "R03"
    Then the call answers 503 with message MSG-GEN-006 and no guessed answer is given
    Then one AC-DENY decision record is written with no case fact

  Scenario: AC10 Two conflicting roles of one caller refuse the session before any authorise request (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given test user "U-7402" holds RW-TEAMMGR and RW-SECADM together, a role pair held in the role_conflict rows of this service
    When "U-7402" signs in and the sign-in access check runs
    Then the session is refused with message MSG-P4-006
    Then no POST /api/recovery/access/v1/authorise request is made

  Scenario: AC11 One call that asks about both areas gets one answer and one record per area and right (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given test user "U-7402" holds RW-TEAMMGR, which has QUEUE_AND_ALLOCATION "U" and no CASE_RECORD right
    When "U-7402" asks for case "RW-2026-000301" in area "QUEUE_AND_ALLOCATION" with right "U" and action "transfer the case", and in area "CASE_RECORD" with right "U" and action "place a legal hold", in one call
    Then the QUEUE_AND_ALLOCATION "U" answer is granted with scope "TEAM"
    Then the CASE_RECORD "U" answer is refused with status 403 and message MSG-P4-002
    Then one AC-READ and one AC-DENY decision record are written, one per area and right

  Scenario: AC12 A transfer reason outside the list is reported as not a member and withholds no right (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given test user "U-7402" holds RW-TEAMMGR with default scope "TEAM" in team "TDR-BKK"
    When "U-7402" asks for case "RW-2026-000301", area "QUEUE_AND_ALLOCATION", right "U", action "transfer the case" and a transfer reason code that is not one of R01 to R06
    Then the answer is granted with scope "TEAM" under matrix version "PM-2026.11"
    Then the answer names the reason list version "TRF-REASON-2026.11" and reports the presented code as not a member of the list
    Then the answer withholds no right, and the MSG-P3-001 refusal is left to the case service
